title: 第807章 孤立无援的第三时代第806章 阴司再扩轮回秩序
content_zh:
一抹灵光在楚元脑海中激荡；
“你叫庞什么？”
“？？？”那主宰一脸茫然：“回大人，我名加莱，却不是庞什么......”
“......既已复现当日之景，为何此界仍在封闭状态？
凡俗生灵寿命短暂，转瞬即逝。
你就不怕他们老死.......”楚元怔了一下：“你冲击阴司，便是为此做准备？”
“正是.......
之所以没有将他们放出，是因为我怕......不是他们，只是一朵相似的花；
并且，‘他们’的身边已经有了一个‘我’.......”
楚元赞许的看了他一眼：“固然是阴差阳错，可......你的机缘到了！”
正在加莱一头雾水之时，楚元对杀戮至尊道：“看住他，此界自有玄妙，我需得亲往参悟！”
杀戮至尊点头：“嗯，你放心。”
一道淡薄的影子从楚元体内迈出；
虽力量有限，却聚集了楚元近乎全部的心神！
他迈步走向那方小小的世界，待融入之前，又扭头问道：“加莱，你以为，为何会如此？”
加莱忙道：“我思索许久，略有所得......
若在一绝对封闭的空间系统内，在足够长的时间尺度下；
万物间最微小的粒子会重新排列，任何已经发生过的场景都有可能再次发生！”
楚元点头，也不做置评：“今次之后，我为你复活亲友。”
加莱浑身一震，不敢置信的看去；

只是楚元却已经没入那方微小世界，也看不见踪迹。
仿佛刚刚踏入，就消融的无处不在......
楚元已经很久没有这么激动过了；
杀戮说错了！
这方世界，看似是‘轮回’；
实则，是‘命运’！
因为，‘一切都注定会再次发生’.......
......
“人去楼空啊......”妖神站在绝灵阵的旧址上，发出感慨；
曾几何时，那道拦住无数诡异的天堑，现在已全然不见了踪迹。
连整片第一战场，都找不出几个活人来......
content_en:
A flash of inspiration stirred in Chu Yuan's mind;
"What's your name Pang?"
"???" The master looked confused: "Sir, my name is Calais, but I am not Pang..."
"...Since the scene of that day has been restored, why is this world still closed?
The life span of mortal beings is short and fleeting.
Aren't you afraid that they will die of old age..." Chu Yuan was stunned for a moment: "You are preparing for this when you attack the Yinsi? "
"Exactly...
The reason I didn't release them was because I was afraid...it wasn't them, just a similar flower;
Moreover, ‘they’ already have an ‘I’ beside them…”
Chu Yuan glanced at him approvingly: "Although it was a mistake, but... your chance has come!"
When Calais was confused, Chu Yuan said to the Killing Supreme: "Watch him, this world has its own mysteries, I need to go and understand it myself!"
The Killing Supreme nodded: "Well, don't worry."
A faint shadow stepped out of Chu Yuan's body;
Although his power is limited, he has gathered almost all of Chu Yuan's mind!
He stepped toward that small world, and before blending in, he turned around and asked, "Calais, why do you think this is happening?"
Jia Lai hurriedly said: "I have thought about it for a long time and got something...
If in an absolutely closed space system and on a long enough time scale;
The tiniest particles in all things will rearrange, and any scene that has happened before may happen again! "
Chu Yuan nodded and did not comment: "After this time, I will resurrect your relatives and friends for you."
Calais was shocked and looked in disbelief;
However, Chu Yuan had already submerged into that tiny world and could not see any trace.
It seems as if just stepping into it, everything melts away...
Chu Yuan has not been so excited for a long time;
Killing is wrong!
This world seems to be ‘reincarnation’;
In fact, it is ‘fate’!
Because, ‘everything is bound to happen again’….
...
"The buildings are empty..." The Demon God stood on the old site of the Jueling Array and sighed;
Once upon a time, the natural moat that blocked countless weird things has now completely disappeared.
Even in the entire first battlefield, there were not even a few living people...
